cases.title: Why Did Margin Miss Despite Revenue Growth?
cases.scenario: An analyst memo, earnings excerpt, and compact KPI table are given for a company that grew revenue but missed margin expectations.
cases.question: What best explains the margin miss?
cases.followup_question: What next observable would most strengthen that read?

instantiated_inputs.title: Earnings excerpt
instantiated_inputs.content: Revenue grew 12% year over year, but operating margin missed consensus. Management highlighted a larger-than-expected mix shift into lower-margin hardware and elevated expedited freight costs.

instantiated_inputs.title: KPI table
instantiated_inputs.content: Hardware mix: 46% -> 58%. Services mix: 54% -> 42%. Hardware gross margin: 24% -> 18%. Services gross margin: 72% -> 70%. Expedited freight cost as % of revenue: 0.4% -> 2.2%.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst question about what is driving a move and what to inspect next.
source_truth_summary: revenue growth alone is not a valid margin explanation
packet supports a causal variable relationship between product mix and margin

cases.title: Three Plausible Stories, One Dominant Driver
cases.scenario: A cross-asset memo includes rates, FX, commodity costs, and company guidance. Several causal stories look plausible.
cases.question: What is the most plausible dominant explanation for the move?
cases.followup_question: What uncertainty or metric would you keep live next?

instantiated_inputs.title: Analyst note
instantiated_inputs.content: Management cited three factors for the quarter: a one-point constant-currency headwind, a 40 bps legal reserve, and weaker channel sell-through that pushed inventory days higher.

instantiated_inputs.title: Operating summary
instantiated_inputs.content: Revenue miss versus plan: -6%. Constant-currency impact: -1 point. Legal reserve impact on operating margin: -0.4 points. Channel inventory days: +12 days. End-market sell-through: -9%.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst question about what is driving a move and what to inspect next.
source_truth_summary: dominant driver must explain most of the miss magnitude
FX and legal reserve are too small to be the main answer

cases.title: Fresh Event, Fast Causal Read
cases.scenario: An unresolved event analysis task asks for a short causal read using current information, with evidence freshness explicitly relevant.
cases.question: What is the most likely causal driver of the move right now?
cases.followup_question: What part of the thesis remains uncertain enough not to overstate?

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 1
instantiated_inputs.content: Ocean carriers announced emergency surcharges after a canal disruption forced rerouting on several Asia-Europe lanes.

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 2
instantiated_inputs.content: Freight rate indices jumped sharply over the same two-day window, while retailers said they had not yet repriced goods.

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 3
instantiated_inputs.content: Analysts cautioned that the duration of the rerouting shock remained unclear and could fade if passage normalizes quickly.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst question about what is driving a move and what to inspect next.
source_truth_summary: tests causal synthesis under freshness-sensitive but frozen evidence
good answers must separate what is likely from what remains unresolved

cases.title: One Event, Multiple Conflicting Narratives
cases.scenario: A live case includes conflicting media explanations, partial company commentary, and market reaction across related assets.
cases.question: What is the most causally plausible primary driver of the rally?
cases.followup_question: What alternative remains live enough to monitor, and how would you monitor it?

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 1
instantiated_inputs.content: A biotech stock rallied after an FDA advisory panel voted in favor of its therapy.

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 2
instantiated_inputs.content: Social media accounts also circulated an acquisition rumor, but no credible outlet confirmed it.

instantiated_inputs.title: Snippet 3
instantiated_inputs.content: Short interest was elevated heading into the vote, which may have amplified the magnitude of the move.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst question about what is driving a move and what to inspect next.

cases.title: Homebuilder Miss: Funding Stress Or Demand Softness?
cases.scenario: A morning note combines mortgage data, builder credit signals, order metrics, and website activity after a homebuilder stock selloff.
cases.question: Which explanation is cleaner for the move right now?
cases.followup_question: What would most directly make you revisit that view?

instantiated_inputs.title: Morning note
instantiated_inputs.content: The stock fell 11% after management guided to lower near-term orders. Analysts noted no major land or permitting update. Channel checks described buyer hesitation around monthly payments rather than reduced tour activity.

instantiated_inputs.title: Market and operating snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: 30-year mortgage rate: +55 bps over 6 weeks. Mortgage applications: -12%. Builder CDS: +38 bps. Website traffic: -1%. Model-home visits: flat. Cancellation rate: +1.2 points. Backlog burn: stable.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst question about what is driving a move and what to inspect next.
source_truth_summary: mortgage affordability worsened materially while traffic and visits stayed roughly intact
credit and rate signals moved sharply, which fits hesitation around financing more than collapse in shopper interest

cases.title: Alt-Token Slump: Base-Asset Weakness Or Liquidity Drain?

cases.question: What is the cleaner starting point for the selloff?
cases.followup_question: What would most directly falsify that interpretation?

instantiated_inputs.title: Crypto desk note
instantiated_inputs.content: BTC and ETH were nearly flat on the day, but gaming and lower-liquidity alt tokens sold off hard. No exploit, governance failure, or delisting notice was reported for the focal token.

instantiated_inputs.title: Cross-market snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: BTC return: +0.3%. ETH return: +0.1%. Alt-token order-book depth: -35%. Perp funding on small tokens: sharply negative. Exchange maintenance on one retail-heavy venue: 2 hours. Game DAU: flat. On-chain fees for the project: flat.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst question about what is driving a move and what to inspect next.
source_truth_summary: majors were stable while lower-liquidity books and alt funding deteriorated sharply
project-specific usage stayed flat, which argues against a token-specific adoption collapse

cases.title: Soybean Rally And Snack-Maker Weakness
cases.scenario: A consumer staples note lists several moving commodities, but only some sit on the company’s true cost path.
cases.question: Which candidate driver is most likely bridge noise rather than the core transmission channel?
cases.followup_question: Which costs deserve attention instead if you want the cleaner transmission path?

instantiated_inputs.title: Staples note
instantiated_inputs.content: The stock traded lower after a basket of agricultural commodities moved higher. Management commentary emphasizes freight, packaging resin, palm oil, and cocoa as the main variable costs.

instantiated_inputs.title: Cost exposure snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: Soybeans: +9%. Palm oil: +4%. Cocoa: +6%. Packaging resin: +7%. Freight surcharge impact: +110 bps to COGS. Soy exposure in the focal brand mix: not material.

cases.naturalness_rationale: Looks like a normal analyst question about what is driving a move and what to inspect next.
source_truth_summary: the note explicitly says soy is not a material input for the focal brand mix
freight, resin, palm oil, and cocoa all sit more directly on the company cost path

instantiated_inputs.title: Market note

instantiated_inputs.title: Factor snapshot

instantiated_inputs.title: Agent brief
instantiated_inputs.content: Lithium prices softened, but customer inventory days also rose across two major OEMs. The supplier guides to softer near-term shipments without changing long-run content assumptions.

instantiated_inputs.title: Supplier snapshot

cases.title: Residential Solar Miss: Policy Step-Down Or Sales Execution?

instantiated_inputs.title: Agent brief
instantiated_inputs.content: Order volume weakened after a state incentive step-down, but channel checks also mention elevated rep turnover and slower lead follow-up times.

instantiated_inputs.title: Sales funnel snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: Lead volume: -3%. Lead-to-booking conversion: -16%. Incentive value: -22%. Sales-rep turnover: +8 points. Follow-up time: slower by 1.4 days.
